newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita CEO sees more Europe bank mergers.
newsitem.headline: Merita CEO sees more Europe bank mergers.

text.p: Excess volume and the planned single currency will force more mergers in the European banking sector, Vesa Vainio, CEO of Finland's largest banking group Merita Oy, said on Wednesday.
"It is likely that consolidation will continue (in Europe), for two reasons: there is still plenty of volume, and then there will be the euro," Vainio told a news conference.
But asked if Merita had been in talks to merge with or tighten cooperation with Swedish SE-Banken or any other foreign bank, he said "No".
Vainio declined to comment on the bank's failed cooperation talks with Finland's two largest insurers Sampo and Pohjola.

Asked whether, as some observers say, Merita was too small internationally and too large for Finland, he said: "In my view Merita is quite a suitable size for Finland and in a European context also a significant regional player."
